comparison: Native structured reader versus compatible ImageBitmap/browser-worker reader in the same packaged EXE
limitations: Five measured readings after one warmup on ONE identical 2560x1440 saved frame, alternating order. Exact unchanged panels can be reused in both readers.
Does not measure a complete move, animation wait, actual game capture, cold startup, instrument OCR or simulations.
The GDI resource test uses a small owned fake window; its capture timing is not a full-resolution game benchmark.
Giboork publishes no implementation source; this adopts the verified Win32/native-processing approach, not its closed reader.
Chromium fallback remains for black/unreadable GDI frames and dimensions greater than 2600 pixels. JS recognition orchestration remains.
